Class VirtualRoomServerAdapter

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.gc49.rmi_socket.virtualMethods.virtualServers.adapters.VirtualServerAdapter
it.polimi.ingsw.gc49.rmi_socket.virtualMethods.virtualServers.adapters.VirtualRoomServerAdapter
All Implemented Interfaces:
Disconnectable, VirtualGameServer, VirtualHallServer, VirtualRoomServer, VirtualServer, Serializable, Remote
public class VirtualRoomServerAdapter extends VirtualServerAdapter
The VirtualRoomServerAdapter class is a specific implementation of the Adapter pattern for players who are currently waiting inside a game room. It routes room-specific commands (such as leaving the room or disconnecting) to the underlying VirtualRoomServer. It safely ignores commands that are invalid for this phase (like in-game actions or hall commands) to prevent out-of-context errors.

    • syncPlayer

      public void syncPlayer(PhasedProxyPlayer proxy) throws Exception
      Synchronizes the client's state if the player reconnects while the room is still in the waiting phase. It forces the client's phase back to ROOM and sends the current room mockup.
      Specified by:
      syncPlayer in class VirtualServerAdapter
      Parameters:
      proxy - the PhasedProxyPlayer representing the reconnected client.
      Throws:
      Exception - if a network error occurs during synchronization.
